safeToFireRealMoneyReason: The DRY_RUN/EARN_MODE double-gate itself is correctly implemented (verified by static trace: real writeContract is unreachable unless DRY_RUN==='false' AND EARN_MODE==='execute' — every other env combination, including unset/typo/case-mismatch, falls through to the simulate-only branch), and the amount math, approval scope, onBehalfOf target, and asset/pool addresses are all correct (see PASS evidence below). However, the real-execution branch NEVER checks the on-chain receipt status before writing 'supplied' to the position ledger (FIND-001, critical) — reproducing a phantom-deposit bug this same codebase already found and fixed elsewhere (skills/earn/lib/deposit-guard.mjs). A reverted or no-op supply (a real possibility given the wallet's ~$0.07 ETH gas buffer) will be recorded as a successful supply, corrupting the automaton's own bookkeeping even though it will not directly destroy the $2 principal. Per the money-safety review rubric (any one defect = FAIL), and because this script is also NOT wired into the automaton's actual entrypoint (FIND-003) and has zero automated test coverage of its own gate logic (FIND-002), it should not be fired for real until FIND-001 (and ideally FIND-005) is fixed.

evidence.description: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) and Aave v3 Base Pool (0xA238Dd80C259a72e81d7e4664a9801593F98d1c5) addresses match the SAME constants independently used in execute-yield.mjs:38-39, cross-verified — correct chain/contract targets.
run.sh (the presumed loop entrypoint) still claims real supply is 'not wired yet' and never calls supply.mjs at all — spec/reality mismatch.
no-gas (eth===0n) and post-reserve-zero (supplyAmt<=0n) skip paths ARE handled correctly and apply before either DRY or REAL branch runs.
approve() receipt status is never checked before proceeding to supply(), risking an avoidable second on-chain revert burning scarce ($0.07) gas.

Amount sizing is correct: supplyAmt = min(want, bal-RESERVE_USDC) in raw 6-decimal USDC units, so it can never exceed the wallet's actual balance; negative/zero cases are caught by the supplyAmt<=0n guard at line 54.

approve() is scoped to exactly supplyAmt (not MaxUint256) and supply()'s onBehalfOf is account.address (the AI's own wallet) — both correct, safer than the MaxUint approve pattern used in execute-yield.mjs:118-121.

CRITICAL: ledger append + 'supplied' decision happen unconditionally after waitForTransactionReceipt, with no rcpt.status==='success' check — a reverted/no-op supply is recorded as a real supply (see FIND-001).
size_supply()/pick_pool() pure logic has 6 passing-shaped unit tests covering reserve math, min-supply floor, allowlist/TVL/APY filtering, and empty-input None cases.

gate booleans traced statically for all four env-var truth-table combinations; only DRY_RUN==='false' AND EARN_MODE==='execute' reaches the real branch — but this is unverified by any automated test (FIND-002).
